projects.name: Alyeschem North Slope Petrochemical Facility
projects.description: First U.S. Arctic petrochemical plant converting North Slope natural gas and captured CO2 into methanol and ultra-low sulfur diesel. Built on existing AIDEA gravel pad; truckable modules fabricated off-site.

sources.title: Alyeschem breaks ground on North Slope facility, Alaska Story
Alyeschem Breaks Ground on North Slope Petrochemical Factory, Alaska Business

projects.open_for: Early construction. Modular process equipment and Arctic-rated MEP specs.

projects.name: Chugach Village in the City
projects.description: Multi-phase 4.35-acre campus at 36th Avenue and Old Seward Highway in Midtown Anchorage. Phase 1 includes commercial space for Chugach subsidiaries, tribal services offices, and Chugach heritage museum/archive.

sources.title: Chugach Alaska Breaks Ground on Village in the City, Alaska Business

projects.open_for: Ground broken. Vertical construction and cultural/museum fit-out specs opening.

projects.name: Don Young Port of Alaska Terminal 1 Replacement
projects.description: Pile-driving and wharf construction for new Cargo Terminal 1 under the Port of Alaska Modernization Program. Manson began 6-ft diameter pile installation in June 2026; $180M federal settlement secured July 2026.

sources.title: Manson Begins Pile Driving for Port of Alaska Terminal 1, DredgeWire
Anchorage and feds settle port lawsuit, Anchorage Daily News

projects.open_for: Active marine construction. Piling, dredging, and waterfront infrastructure specs.

projects.name: Tanana Chiefs Conference Rampart Health Clinic

sources.title: RFP, Rampart Clinic General Contractor, Tanana Chiefs Conference
